title: A Queen With a Fork
setup: Your b-pawn is one step from the eighth rank, and the black king is standing on that very rank.
hint: A new queen arrives with check. Before you play it, look at what else the promotion square attacks.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b8=Q+}} is check along the eighth rank and attacks the rook on d6 down the b8-h2 diagonal at the same time. Black has to answer the check, with {{Kh7}} or by blocking with Rd8, and either way the queen collects the rook, as in {{Qxd6}}. Promote where the new piece does two jobs.
